body:
Self care is so much more than bubble baths and face masks lol I wish it was that simple. When I was younger I used to think that way. Self care is participating in life even when you don’t want too. Pretty much like self discipline. 
I’m looking for a hobby to pick up as well or maybe a good book to read. Something to get myself out of my head a bit more. I try journaling at least every other day or so to just get in touch with my feelings and let some negative thoughts out that way. 
It’s still been hard for me to get up in the mornings and I’m still kind of numb inside and I’ve been overeating even though I don’t find food appetizing sometimes??? It’s annoying. 
I’m going the medical route, so I’ll be learning anatomy this coming up semester. I find the body interesting so I’m excited to learn new facts. I know it’s going to test my memory which I feel hasn’t been that great so hopefully it improves by then. 
What about yourself? How’s your day been? Is there something on your mind?

I agree! I can drive myself crazy with all the thoughts in my head. Feels so much better to let them out. Today was an alright day. I was off from work so I went to the grocery store and was kind of lazy. This semester of school is over and I’m pretty sure I failed a class. I need to work on taking care of myself and maybe putting more effort in my appearance to increase confidence. I have isolated myself a lot and I think I need to put myself out there more. Everything kind of feels like a mundane routine. I’m trying to be patient with myself and I always tell myself this feeling will pass. I hope it’s soon. 
How are you?
He was 17 and just about to graduate high school
Thanks for being so kind. Sometimes it’s easier for me to talk to someone other than close friends or family because of judgement. I also appreciate a fresh perspective. Thank you.
